1.Tips: A hero's maximum level is determined by their ascension level.

2.Tips: You can harvest AFK Rewards continuously for up to 12 hours. Don't forget to collect them!

3.Tips: The quality and amount of AFK Rewards is determined by your campaign progress.

4.Tips: All resources used on a hero will be returned to you if you choose to reset them.

5.Tips: There are no level requirements for equipment.

6.Tips: Certain equipment can give your heroes factional attribute bonuses.

7.Tips: Take advantage of factional advantages to make your battles easier.

8.Tips: Deploy beasts to greatly enhance your squad's prowess in battle.

9.Tips: Participate in the Arena of Heroes to earn a large amount of resources every day.

10.Tips: Faction Advantages: Lightbearers > Maulers> Wilders > Graveborn > Lightbearers

11.Tips: If you're unable to defeat a boss try changing your battle formation!

12.Tips: Guild hunts offer significant amounts of loot and resources. Don't forget to take part!
